description: Source code implementing switch configuration API functions for user space, including netlink communication, attribute handling, and device management.

methods.name: swlib_list
methods.description: Lists all switch devices by initializing netlink connection, requesting device list, and freeing resources.

methods.name: swlib_connect
methods.description: Connects to a switch device by name, returning a switch_dev structure.

methods.name: swlib_scan
methods.description: Scans and populates switch device attributes and configurations.

methods.name: swlib_print_portmap
methods.description: Prints port mapping information for a switch device, filtered by segment if provided.

methods.name: swlib_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a switch device.

methods.name: swlib_free_all
methods.description: Frees a linked list of switch devices.
